cloud.title: Nimly account
cloud.description: Sign in with the account you use in the official app.

location.title: Location
location.description: Choose which location to expose in Home Assistant.

mirror.title: Nimly mirror
mirror.description:
Pick the real lock (paired in ZHA) and the MQTT prefix the emulator uses.

{detected}

channels.title: Mirror channels
channels.description: Choose what should be mirrored between the Nimly app side and the real lock.

custom.title: Custom channels
custom.description: Enable one channel at a time.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The cloud session for {email} is no longer valid. Enter the password to reconnect; the lock keeps working locally meanwhile.

abort.already_configured: This account or lock is already configured.
abort.provisioned: The bridge is provisioned and connected.
abort.no_address: Could not read the device address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the vendor cloud.
error.provision_failed: Provisioning failed – check the network and try again.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to ask the account for new activity. Shorter is more responsive and asks more of the vendor's API.

firmware.title: Firmware source
firmware.description: The OTA manifest URL the update entities read. Keep the default unless you host your own builds.

reserved.title: Master slots
reserved.description: How many slots the lock reserves for master credentials. The manuals say 0-2 on every model but the Code Pro, which reserves only slot 0. Slot 0 is never written.

channels.title: Mirror channels
channels.description: Change what is mirrored. Each channel also has a switch you can toggle later.

slot_set_pin.title: Set a PIN
slot_set_pin.description: The code is written to the lock and never stored in Home Assistant.

slot_clear.title: Clear a slot
slot_clear.description: Clears the credential on the lock and forgets the slot's local data.

progress.slot_set_pin: Sending the PIN to the lock...

error.lock_unreachable: The lock did not respond. Press a button on the lock to wake it and try again.

pin_required_remote.name: Cloud PIN required for remote unlock

new_slot.title: Slot {slot} needs a name
new_slot.description: A {kind} is registered in slot {slot}. Give the user a name so Home Assistant notifications show the right person.

init.title: Name slot {slot}
init.description: Enter the name of the person using slot {slot}.

emulator_not_joined.title: The emulator is not on the Zigbee network
emulator_not_joined.description: The emulator answers Home Assistant but is not joined to the Nimly bridge. Open the Nimly app's add-device flow so the bridge allows the join; the emulator retries by itself.

init.title: Repair the app registration
init.description: The emulator answers Home Assistant but the Nimly bridge refuses its join. Usually the app still has the old lock registered, which blocks the re-pairing; removing that record is exactly what the app's remove-device does. Submit to do it from here.

next.title: Now add the device in the app
next.description: Open the Nimly app, add a device and start the search. The emulator is steering on its own and joins within seconds of the bridge's window opening. This repair closes by itself when it does.

abort.reset_failed: The app registration could not be removed (no matching cloud device).

cloud_feedback_stale.title: The vendor cloud is not answering
cloud_feedback_stale.description: A change was sent towards the Nimly app but never appeared in the account. The bridge's cloud link is likely stuck - power-cycle the Nimly Connect Bridge.

slot_conflict.title: An app credential for slot {slot} could not be stored
slot_conflict.description: The app provisioned a credential for slot {slot}, but it could not be stored on the lock: {reason}. Nothing was overwritten. Free a slot and try again in the app.

cloud_link_ambiguous.title: Cloud credentials need linking for slot {slot}
cloud_link_ambiguous.description: The lock holds a {type} in slot {slot}, but {count} cloud accesses of that type have no slot yet. Link them before a sync so the app attributes the right person; nimly.link_credential does it, and nimly.audit shows the state.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Ask the account for new activity right now.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which account to refresh. Leave out for all of them.

fetch_history.name: Fetch activity history
fetch_history.description: Return the activities Home Assistant has collected, newest first.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Limit the result to one lock.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of activities to return.

set_lock.name: Lock or unlock through the cloud
set_lock.description: An optional second control path. The local path is faster and keeps working without internet.

locked.name: Locked
locked.description: True to lock, false to unlock.

gateway_scan.name: Open the bridge pairing window
gateway_scan.description: Asks the bridge to accept a new device, so a module or an emulator can join from Home Assistant.

start.name: Start
start.description: True to open the window, false to close it.

probe.name: Call the vendor API (diagnostics)
probe.description: Calls paths on the vendor API and returns the status and a redacted body. Used to map the API; not needed for normal use.

paths.name: Paths
paths.description: Paths relative to the API root, or objects with path, method, json and headers.

set_ieee.name: Provision IEEE address
set_ieee.description: Sends an IEEE address to the emulator, which stores it in NVS and reboots. Defaults to the real lock module's own address, because the vendor cloud only accepts known modules.

ieee.name: IEEE address
ieee.description: Address in the form 00:11:22:33:44:55:66:77. Empty uses the lock's own.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to provision. Leave out to target all of them.

ota_install.name: Install bridge firmware (OTA)
ota_install.description: Sends a firmware URL to the bridge, which downloads it, writes the next application partition and reboots. Used by the update entity, but can also be run manually.

url.name: URL
url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to the application binary.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which bridge to update. Leave out to target all of them.

provision_wifi.name: Provision Wi-Fi (BLE/Improv)
provision_wifi.description: Connects to the bridge over Bluetooth and sends Wi-Fi credentials using Improv. Used by the discovery flow, but can also be run manually.

address.name: Bluetooth address
address.description: The device's BLE address, for example from nRF Connect or from discovery.

ssid.name: Network (SSID)
ssid.description: The Wi-Fi network the bridge should join.

set_slot_name.name: Name a lock slot
set_slot_name.description: Stores a person's name for a lock slot so events and notifications say who did what.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The lock slot the credential lives in.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to name a slot on. Leave out to target all of them.

set_pin.name: Write a PIN to a slot
set_pin.description: Writes a PIN code to the real lock and names the slot. The code is never stored in Home Assistant.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The slot to write the code to.

name.name: Name
name.description: Optional person name for the slot.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.

clear_slot.name: Clear a lock slot
clear_slot.description: Clears the credential on the lock and forgets the slot's local data.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.

read_lock_attributes.name: Read the lock's attributes
read_lock_attributes.description: Reads the lock's standard DoorLock attributes over Zigbee and returns them. PIN codes are never read.

attributes.name: Attributes
attributes.description: Attribute names or ids. Leave out for the default list.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.

set_auto_lock.name: Set the lock's auto-lock
set_auto_lock.description: Writes the lock's own auto-relock setting over Zigbee and reads it back.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: true turns auto-lock on, false turns it off.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.

set_sound_volume.name: Set the lock's sound volume
set_sound_volume.description: Writes the lock's own sound volume over Zigbee and reads it back.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to act on. Leave out to target all of them.

fetch_journal.name: Read the lock journal
fetch_journal.description: Returns the lock's timeline of access and admin events, newest last.

person.name: Person
person.description: Only entries whose name contains this text.

action.name: Action
action.description: Only entries with this action, for example unlock or pin_set.

since.name: Since
since.description: Only entries at or after this ISO timestamp.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to read. Leave out to read all of them.

create_guest_code.name: Create a guest code
create_guest_code.description: Writes a PIN to the lock, names the slot and remembers the window. The code is returned once and never stored. Expiry is enforced by Home Assistant, so the code works offline during the window.

code.name: Code
code.description: 4-8 digits. Leave out for a random 6-digit code.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Leave out to use the lowest free user slot.

until.name: Valid until
until.description: ISO timestamp when the code is cleared. Leave out for no expiry.

one_time.name: One-time
one_time.description: The code revokes itself the first time it opens the door.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to use. Leave out for all of them.

revoke_guest_code.name: Revoke a guest code
revoke_guest_code.description: Clears the code now and forgets the guest window.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to use. Leave out for all of them.

list_guests.name: List guest codes
list_guests.description: Returns the active guest windows (names, slots and end times - never the codes).

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to read. Leave out to read all of them.

create_recurring_guest.name: Create a recurring guest
create_recurring_guest.description: A guest whose code never changes but is only valid inside weekly windows. Home Assistant writes the code when a window opens and clears it when it closes.

code.name: Code
code.description: 4-8 digits. Leave out for a random 6-digit code. It stays the same for as long as the guest exists.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: A list of windows: {days: [mon..sun], start: HH:MM, end: HH:MM}. An end at or before the start crosses midnight.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Leave out to use the lowest free user slot.

paused.name: Paused
paused.description: Create it paused; nothing is written to the lock until it is resumed.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to use. Leave out for all.

update_guest.name: Update a guest
update_guest.description: Change a guest's name, code, schedule, pause or expiry; the change takes effect immediately.

code.name: Code
code.description: A new 4-8 digit code; the slot is rewritten.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: New windows (turns a simple guest into a recurring one).

paused.name: Paused
paused.description: Pause or resume a recurring guest.

until.name: Valid until
until.description: New ISO expiry for a simple guest.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to use. Leave out for all.

reset_app_registration.name: Reset the app registration
reset_app_registration.description: Removes this lock's device record from the vendor account, exactly like the app's remove-device does. Needed before re-pairing after an eviction; run the app's add-device search afterwards.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which mirror to use. Leave out for all.

cleanup_cloud.name: Clean up cloud registry entries
cleanup_cloud.description: Removes entities and devices left behind when the vendor account no longer lists their lock, and migrates surviving entries onto the lock's serial. Runs automatically at setup; call this to run it on demand.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: True to report what would change without touching the registry.

cloud_guests.name: List the cloud's guests
cloud_guests.description: Reads the vendor account's guest users (the app's Guest user list): identity, validity window and which credential types they hold. The cloud never returns credential values.

entry_id.name: Account entry
entry_id.description: Optional config entry id when more than one account is configured.

sync_cloud.name: Sync local guests to the cloud
sync_cloud.description: For every local recurring guest with a stored code: ensure a cloud identity and a PIN access. Runs dry by default and reports exactly what it would create; the cloud record only adds attribution and app notifications, the code already works in the lock.

entry_id.name: Account entry
entry_id.description: Optional config entry id when more than one account is configured.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Defaults to true: report the plan without writing to the cloud.

audit.name: Audit the lock, catalog and cloud
audit.description: Read-only drift report: which local guests miss a cloud identity or access, and which cloud guests the local catalog does not know. Nothing is changed.

entry_id.name: Account entry
entry_id.description: Optional config entry id when more than one account is configured.

link_credential.name: Link a credential to a vendor user
link_credential.description: Records which vendor identity owns a credential in a slot (pin, tag or finger). Used to resolve an ambiguous cloud link reported by the repair flow or nimly.audit.

entry_id.name: Mirror entry
entry_id.description: Optional config entry id when more than one lock is configured.
